chapter: Family band and learning to play
title: Alfonso Trent's band and its uniforms at the Adolphus
summary: Tate explains where the family band got its uniform habit: Trent's band at the Adolphus Hotel in Dallas.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening

blocks.x: From Trent, Alfonso Trent's band. They had -- that was the one -- they had about 12, 14 uniforms. They used to be hanging up in my auntie's -- my other auntie's place and they were playing the Dolphus Hotel in Dallas, which was unknown. They was the only black band that played the Dolphus Hotel and they played there like a year and a half at a time and they were broadcasting from there. That really turned me on, you know, and they was sharp, man.
